title: One Backup holds all saves + settings (mm-assist, music, high contrast), notebook, errand both sides, zk, bestWaveA; Town and Hub give the same bundle (b14-05, b14-13)
steps: Play the Realm (pick Thicket Ranger, fight until a notebook page is written)
Hub > Backup > Back up everything; Town (Play offline) > Backup
Profile with mm-assist {dmg:70,aim:2}, mm-music 1, mm-high-contrast 1, town errand s:1, realm errand p:1 d:1, zk 3, bestWaveA 1: Town Backup button
expected: One file with every save key and every setting
actual: Hub and Town downloads were identical full bundles (8 keys incl. pixeltown-notebook-v1 after real play). Town chat: 'Backup saved: 6 saves and settings in one file.' The file held mm-assist {dmg:70,aim:2}, mm-music, mm-high-contrast, notebook, town errand {s:1}, bestWaveA 1, realm zk 3 and realm errand {p:1,d:1}.

title: Restore the full bundle on a fresh phone (touch): confirm lists settings separately, every value comes back
steps: Hub > tap Backup > Restore from a file > pick the Town bundle
Read the list, tap Confirm restore
actual: Confirm reads 'A full backup made 2026-11-24 (build 2026-11-24-r4). 3 saves, 3 settings.' with 'assist setting (setting)' etc. After Confirm: errand, bestWaveA, zk, realm errand, mm-assist {dmg:70,aim:2}, music, high contrast and notebook all identical to the source device.

title: Old and junk files: old town-only file restores; junk / array / empty refused with nothing changed
steps: Hub > Backup > Restore from a file: old-town.json (no format, just name/species/resources)
Then junk text, [1,2,3], an empty file
expected: Old file restores after confirm; junk changes nothing
actual: Old file: 'An old town-only file. 1 saves, 0 settings.' -> town save replaced, settings untouched. Junk/empty: 'That file is not valid JSON. Nothing was changed.' Array: 'That file does not look like a Mad Maze backup. Nothing was changed.' Storage unchanged each time.

title: Two Realm tabs: notebook pages and kill stats are never lost or rolled back
steps: One context, tab A Realm: fight 25 s (2 first kills -> 2 notebook pages, kills 3)
Open tab B Realm, fight 25 s (kills 5)
Back to tab A, fight 10 s, check storage
expected: Union of pages, max of counters
actual: Notebook kept both pages through tab B and tab A writes; stats.kills went 3 -> 5 and tab A's later save did not drop it back to 3. 0 page errors.

title: Blocked localStorage on Hub, Town, Realm, Lantern (phone): no page error; Backup says why
steps: 390x844 context whose localStorage getter throws SecurityError
Open Hub, tap Backup > Back up everything; open Town, Realm, Lantern
actual: 0 page errors on all four pages. Hub Backup: 'Could not read your saves here (site data is blocked), so there is nothing to back up.'

title: A bundle with one unknown key, or one out-of-range setting, is refused as a whole with an unnamed 'damaged' message (b14-r2-N01 still open, now also hits settings)
steps: Hub > Restore from a file: a version-2 bundle with a valid town save + key 'pixeltown-hoverboard-v9'
Again with a valid town save + mm-assist {dmg:0, aim:99}
expected: Skip and name the bad entry (like damaged keys already are), restore the rest; or clamp the setting
actual: Both: 'That backup file is damaged. Nothing was changed.' The entry at fault is not named, and a bundle from a newer build (forward key) cannot be restored at all.
suspect: game/shared/mm-backup.js plan(): unknown key / cleaner-undefined path fails the whole plan

title: Backup status line partly hidden under the fixed Daily gift / Map footer on phone
steps: 390x844, blocked storage (also seen with normal storage when the panel sits low)
expected: The status line scrolls into view
actual: The last line ('blocked), so there is nothing to back up.') sits under the fixed footer; the player must scroll to read it.
suspect: game/hub/index.html footer overlap / mm-backup-ui.js status (no scrollIntoView)

title: Realm menu 'More settings' / Assist steps unreachable while the hero picker is up; first-time player sees two different settings panels
steps: Click Thicket Ranger, then the Menu button (or Esc then Menu)
actual: In my scripted runs the Heroes dialog (#realm-hero) kept intercepting clicks on the Menu button for 6 s after picking a hero via the card, and the gear (#mm-gear-btn) opens a separate settings panel (palette / HUD size / comfort) without the Damage taken / Aim help steps. I could not set Assist through the UI in the time I had; may be my input path, not confirmed by hand.
